title: Betta Health Information Disclaimer | BettaFish.website
description: Understand the limits of online betta health guidance and when professional aquatic veterinary help may be necessary.
intro: Health pages can help you organize observations and identify urgency, but they cannot examine your fish or provide an individualized diagnosis.

sections.heading: Before acting on a health page
items: Test temperature, ammonia, nitrite and other relevant water conditions.
Read the exact product label and check whether its formulation differs in your country.
Avoid combining medications or rapidly changing several conditions without reliable guidance.
Seek aquatic veterinary help for rapid decline, severe breathing difficulty, major injury, uncertain diagnosis or treatment failure.

sections.heading: No treatment guarantee
paragraphs: Similar signs may result from different causes, and an apparently correct treatment can fail when the underlying problem is different.
BettaFish.website will not claim that a medication, salt protocol, temperature change or home intervention guarantees recovery.

sections.heading: Prepublication restriction
sections.text: Disease and treatment articles remain blocked until the assigned aquatic veterinarian approves each exact corrected version and the review record is complete.
